about: DATA for tools/place-pursuits-on-a-life-map: where the person's own map is kept in their lists and where their pursuits are read from. `own_map`: the person's own map list, as the starter map's own `list.id` names it and Trillion's lists keep it (row type = list id). `pursuits`: the record kind and fields a person's pursuits are read from when none are handed in. The starter map itself is never read here: it is the run's input `settings`.

words.no_settings: Hand in settings: the starter map ({ areas: [...], list: { id, label, title_field, fields }, words: { ... } }).
words.bad_pursuits: pursuits is a list of { title, areas: [area id] }.
words.bad_settings: settings is the starter map: { areas: [...], list: { id, label, title_field, fields }, words: { ... } }.
